name: Balm Massage Studio
tagline: Therapeutic and relaxation massage in a quiet two-room studio on Alder Street. Sixty or ninety minutes, and no rush out the door.
credentials: Licensed massage therapist (LMT #MA-40218), 11 years in practice
hours_note: Closed Sundays and Mondays. Last booking 90 minutes before close.
offer: First visit? Take 15% off any 90-minute session

first_visit.title: Arrive, shoes off, a glass of water
first_visit.note: Come ten minutes early. There's a short health form — injuries, medication, anything that's bothering you this week.

first_visit.title: Five minutes of talking first
first_visit.note: Nora asks where it hurts, what you do all day, and how much pressure you like. You can change your mind on the table.

first_visit.title: On the table, under a warm sheet
first_visit.note: Undress to your comfort. Only the area being worked on is ever uncovered. Talk or don't — both are normal.

first_visit.title: Slow up, and one thing to take home
first_visit.note: Water, a minute to sit, and one stretch for whatever was tightest. Rebook if you like; there's no pressure to.

review.quote: I came in for my neck and she found the knot in my shoulder blade that's been causing it for three years. First night in months I didn't wake up with a headache.
review.name: Daniel R.

addons.name: Cupping on the back and shoulders

policies.title: Cancelling
policies.note: Free up to 24 hours before. Inside 24 hours we charge half the session — unless you're ill. Then stay home, and we'll rebook you.

policies.title: Running late
policies.note: We'll still finish on time for the next client, so a late start is a shorter session at the full price.

policies.title: Insurance and HSA
policies.note: We give you an itemized receipt for your insurer, and HSA and FSA cards work like any other card.

policies.title: Gift cards
policies.note: Any session, any amount, by email or on thick card in an envelope. Good for a year.

art_direction.identity: A small, honest massage studio: river-stone grey canvas, basalt ink, and one massage-oil amber. Golden-hour photography of hands, sheets, and stones — never faces, never candles-and-orchids. Warm through light and material, not through cream and pink. Hairline rules, no cards-on-cards, no gradients except the dark wash that keeps text readable over the hero photograph.
art_direction.type: Hedvig Letters Serif for every heading at regular weight, tight tracking; one word in the hero headline gets a hand-drawn amber loop (the circled utility). Manrope for all text, navigation, and labels.
art_direction.color: One accent: massage-oil amber (bg-primary), always with basalt text — the book button, the body-map band, and the hand-drawn loop. The treatments band uses basalt (bg-secondary) as a dark ground. Everything else is stone canvas, lighter stone surface, basalt ink, and muted text. Never add a second accent.
art_direction.signature: The body map — an intake-form drawing of a back with numbered pins at the places people hold tension, each pin tied to a line saying what it feels like and what to book. Keep it wherever the design evolves; a new focus area gets a new pin.
art_direction.voice: A therapist talking plainly about bodies: specific muscles, real minutes, honest policies. Short sentences. No 'sanctuary', 'journey', 'indulge', 'pamper', or exclamation marks.
